plain_english: Homage to the world-formed, whose form is beyond the world — to the ever-divine-shining, to the self of unending power.
You alone are you; I alone am I. You alone are; I am not at all. As for you and me both being — where is there homage, homage?
sanskrit_cite: tvaṃ tvamevāhamevāhaṃ tvamevāsi na cāsmyaham | ahaṃ tvamityubhau na sto yatra tasmai namo namaḥ

plain_english: Inside the body, sought by me always — you as self, and the self is never seen. Whatever is seen is you alone, that.
sanskrit_cite: antardehe mayā nityaṃ tvamātmā ca gaveṣitaḥ | na dṛṣṭastvaṃ nacaivātmā yacca dṛṣṭaṃ tvameva tat

plain_english: Of your devotee who well knows your form, now again: having seen you as the self's form — to you homage, to me homage.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktasya sajñātabhavadrūpasyatha me punaḥ | tvāmātmarūpaṃ samprekṣya tubhyaṃ mahyaṃ namo namaḥ

plain_english: What finesse of going is there, what should be done, thus, from the root? Of yours, made of your magic power — by what, in what, from where is the dissolving?
sanskrit_cite: etadgacananaipuṇyaṃ yatkartavyetimūlayā | bhavanmāyātmanastasya kena kasmin kuto layaḥ

plain_english: I, you; you, I — thus there is no duality of us anywhere. Only the wish to grasp samādhi: that is what the abiding of difference is.
sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ tvaṃ tvamahaṃ ceti bhinnatā nāvayoḥ kvacit | samādhigrahaṇecchāyā bhedasyāvasthitirhyasau

plain_english: You, I, and so on — so endless, ever in you, they find no room. Words, then — whence the world?
sanskrit_cite: tvamahaṃ so'yamityādi so'nantāni sadā tvayi | na labhante cāvakāśaṃ vacanāni kuto jagat

plain_english: Enough of difference-talk. From chewing the sap of devotion to you — all this is one, at peace, though even to say so is shy.
sanskrit_cite: alaṃ bhedānukathayā tvadbhaktirasacarvaṇāt | sarvamekamidaṃ śāntamiti vaktuṃ ca lajjate

plain_english: When your own form expands — you and I and the whole world. When its withdrawal is born — neither you, nor I, nor indeed the world.
sanskrit_cite: tvatsvarūpe jṛmbhamāṇe tvaṃ cāhaṃ cākhilaṃ jagat | jāte tasya tirodhāne na tvaṃ nāhaṃ na vai jagat

plain_english: Waking, dreaming, deep sleep and the rest — holding them as your own rays. By your own will you shine like an actor, and yet you are partless in truth.
sanskrit_cite: jāgratasvapnasuṣuptyādyā dhārayaṃśca nijāḥ kalāḥ | svecchayā bhāsi naṭavan niṣkalo'si ca tattvataḥḥ
